title: Wrong week number
body: In Europe week starts from Monday. In this case week number on this calendar is wrong. If you put first day of the week Sunday it shows normally, but next Sunday is again on another week what is very wrong. In google calendar week numbers shows correctly.
author: MG_SAAB

title: Missing elementar  options
body:
You cannot set a task for a custom period only to be visible at a very time. Once you set custom period your whole day is busy with that task.

Other elements work fine, but it is really frustrating that the app is not better than it is
author: eskorada

title: Good Calendar app
body: Good app, the only missing thing is that in 2923 I still can't share a calendar event. Select event > Share > email/iMessage/WhatsApp.
